intended_object: The map M(A) → M(A[X]) that sends a point to its constant point, for the convolution-points monoid M(A) = Hom_{R-alg}(H, A) of an R-bialgebra H. A point g goes to C ∘ g, where C : A → A[X] is the structure map. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The body is the library's `AlgHom.mapValue`, which sends a point f to φ ∘ f as a monoid homomorphism of convolution monoids, applied to φ = `IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R A (Polynomial A)`. That φ is the R-algebra map `algebraMap A A[X] = C`. So the definition is the pullback of points along the structure map A → A[X], exactly as the docstring says.

The setting is already general: R is any commutative semiring, H any R-bialgebra (no commutativity, no antipode), and A any commutative R-algebra. The definition is a specific map, so it is not too narrow just for being specific.

Mathlib has no functor-of-points construction on convolution monoids of this kind, so there is no counterpart to cite.
